relations.subject: Ashok Kumar Chatterjee
relations.evidence: Ashok Kumar Chatterjee (27 November 1925 – 21 April 2021) was an Indian philosopher and Buddhist scholar who taught philosophy at the Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi.

relations.subject: Ashok Kumar Chatterjee
relations.evidence: He pursued his education under his Guruji professor T. R. V. Murti of Banaras Hindu University.

relations.subject: T. R. V. Murti
relations.evidence: professor T. R. V. Murti of Banaras Hindu University

relations.subject: Ashok Kumar Chatterjee
relations.role: B.A., M.A., and Ph.D. in philosophy
relations.evidence: He attended the Central Hindu School of Banaras Hindu University throughout high school and intermediate studies, and then continued his B.A., M.A., and Ph.D. in philosophy.

relations.subject: Ashok Kumar Chatterjee
relations.evidence: He is known to have frequently engaged in philosophical discussions with leading figures in Indian philosophy like Kalidas Bhattacharya.

relations.subject: Ashok Kumar Chatterjee
relations.role: Sayajirao Gaekwad Fellow in the Department of Philosophy
relations.evidence: He was a Sayajirao Gaekwad Fellow from 1947 to 1950 in the Department of Philosophy, Banaras Hindu University.

relations.subject: Ashok Kumar Chatterjee
relations.role: professor and head of the philosophy department
relations.evidence: Chatterjee was a professor from 1950 to 1963 at Agra University and became the head of the philosophy department.

relations.subject: Ashok Kumar Chatterjee
relations.role: professor and the head of the Department of Philosophy and Religion
relations.evidence: he joined the university in 1963 and retired in 1985 as the professor and the head of the Department of Philosophy and Religion.
